content:
Maya CS: Quick one  we need a customer note for EU onboarding customers who saw slowed onboarding jobs last night. Draft below, keep credits and escalation clear.

Olga CS-Mgr: Please prioritize renewals and pilots for personal outreach. Trials can get the automated note.

Maya CS: Segment counts: Trials: 7; Renewals (<=60d): 3; Pilots: 4.

Laura SRE: Short summary: autoscaler under-provisioned under KV cache pressure during a traffic spike. Emergency capacity bump at 22:38 UTC mitigated the issue; permanent fix in next deploy (~03:20 UTC).

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-20T22:05Z  Embedding inference throttling (eu pool). Severity P2. Status: mitigated.

Kofi Support: Add an "If you need urgent help" escalation path and the status page link. Also create CS ticket template for stuck jobs.

Maya CS: Draft v1 (please inline edits):

"Hi {{CustomerName}},

Were reaching out about a performance degradation you may have seen during onboarding jobs on March 20 (approx 22:0022:45 UTC). A subset of EU inference nodes experienced temporary throttling which affected some embedding and short-chat onboarding runs.

What happened: an autoscaling threshold under-provisioned capacity during a traffic spike for the EU inference pool (v2.4).

What we did for you:
- Emergency capacity bump at 22:38 UTC and prioritized retried onboarding jobs where possible.
- Trials: 10% automatic usage credit for the impacted window.
- Renewals & pilots: up to 15% credit and an offer for an expedited re-run with live assist (personal outreach). Credits are capped per account.

Next steps:
- If you see stalled jobs, reply here or open a ticket at <support-link> with the onboarding job id.
- Well post a high-level incident summary on our status page and follow up with an RCA.

Note: Dedicated Reserved pools and Private deployments were not affected. Embeddings batch jobs will be retried automatically unless you opt out.

Apologies for the disruption.

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success"

Olga CS-Mgr: Change wording to "up to 15% credit for renewals/pilots, 10% for trials; capped per account". Require CSM outreach for renewals/pilots.

Noah Finance: OK to cap credits at $5,000 per account for this incident. Use "up to" language.

Sam Product: Wording ok. Please include the pool version (v2.4) and explicit note that Dedicated/Private unaffected.

Ravi AE: I'll draft personalized email templates for the 3 renewals and collect contact details.

Kofi Support: Ticket template created: CS-ONBOARD-THROTTLE. Fields: account, job id, timestamp, retry status, assigned CSM. Escalation: @oncall-sre -> cs-ops-runbook.

Laura SRE: High-level RCA will be posted EOD tomorrow; full technical postmortem within 72 hours.

Maya CS: Final plan: automated trials outbound at 07:00 UTC tomorrow; personalized outreach to renewals/pilots by 09:30 PT. Ill drop the status link into the message before send. Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
